name: vscode-discord-presence
description: Show your VS Code activity on Discord

discordPresence.enabled.description: Show your VS Code activity on Discord.

discordPresence.clientId.description: Application ID of your own Discord application. Its name is shown after "Playing". Leave empty to use the built-in one ("Visual Studio Code").

discordPresence.showFileName.description: Show the name of the file you are editing.

discordPresence.showLanguage.description: Show the language name and icon.

discordPresence.showVSCodeLogo.description: Show the small VS Code logo in the corner of the language icon.

discordPresence.hiddenWorkspaces.markdownDescription: Workspaces where the activity is hidden. Each item is a workspace name (e.g. `my-app`) or a folder path (e.g. `C:\work`), which also covers the folders inside it. Case is ignored. See `#discordPresence.hiddenWorkspaceMode#` for how they are hidden.

enumDescriptions: Show only "Editing a file" and the VS Code logo.
discordPresence.hiddenWorkspaceMode.description: How the activity is hidden in the workspaces in Hidden Workspaces.

discordPresence.idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes after VS Code loses focus before showing Idling. 0 shows it immediately.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
